summary: Full backend + frontend regression for new auth/admin/booking iteration. All 15 pytest backend tests pass (auth, properties public, admin CRUD, photo upload via Emergent object storage, bookings lifecycle). Frontend end-to-end flows validated: /admin unauthenticated redirect, wrong-password rejection, successful admin login, dashboard stat cards (15 casas / 0 pending / 0 approved), /admin/casas lists 15, Nova casa + save + photo upload, logout clears token. Property detail (/casa/:id) booking widget opens pt-BR calendar; 7-night range triggers Pacote Semana badge; Reservar via WhatsApp POSTs /api/bookings (200) and opens wa.me/5511981389572 URL with correct property/dates/total.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines `logger` at module bottom (line 428) but references `logger.info` inside @app.on_event('startup') (lines 203, 209, 226, 231, 233). Works today because startup runs after module load, but it is fragile ordering — move logging.basicConfig/getLogger above the startup handler.
Login endpoint sets cookie with secure=True + samesite='none' which is required for cross-site; fine for production but will not persist on plain http dev. Not an issue in current preview env.

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Frontend currently uses Bearer header so it works, but tighten origins before production.

init_storage() is a synchronous requests call executed inside async handlers (upload_photo, download). For higher load, wrap storage I/O in a threadpool (run_in_executor) to avoid blocking the event loop.
server.py is 433 lines and still manageable, but auth/photo/booking concerns could be split into routers for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 15 properties on first startup from /app/backend/seed_properties.json. Admin seeded from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env. During testing I created and cleaned up TEST_ properties and bookings; final property count = 15.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend route for property detail is /casa/:id (NOT /property/:id). Admin area is /admin/* with ProtectedRoute. Token stored at localStorage.bahiastay_token. WhatsApp number 5511981389572 verified end-to-end. Backend objstore upload returns /api/files/{path} and the file-streaming endpoint serves bytes with correct Content-Type. Photo upload confirmed working against live Emergent integration proxy.
